api-key.description: **Recommended.** Signvoy API key. Create one in Workspace Settings → API Keys and pass it as `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`. The key implies its workspace, so `X-Workspace-Id` is optional when using an API key.

clerk-jwt.description: Clerk session JWT — used internally by the Signvoy dashboard. Not recommended for external integrations; use an API key instead.

workspace-id.name: X-Workspace-Id
workspace-id.description: Workspace ID for multi-tenancy. Optional when authenticating with an API key (the key already implies its workspace).

slug.description: URL-friendly slug (auto-generated from name if omitted). Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional hyphens.
Updated URL-friendly slug. Must be lowercase alphanumeric with optional hyphens.

email.description: Email address of the person to invite

role.description: New role for the member. Note: Owner role cannot be assigned via this endpoint.

draftVersionId.description: ID of the initial draft version

uploadUrl.description: Presigned PUT URL for uploading the source PDF directly to storage. Upload the PDF bytes to this URL with Content-Type: application/pdf.

publishedBy.description: Clerk user ID of the publisher

pdfUrl.description: Presigned PDF URL (included when explicitly requested)

ownerId.description: Clerk user ID of the owner

archivedAt.description: Unix ms when archived (null if active)

draftVersion.description: Current draft version (null if none exists)

publishedVersion.description: Current published version (null if never published)

roleKey.description: Template role key this recipient fills (matches `version.content.recipients[].key`)

templateId.description: Template UUID to create document from

message.description: Message to include with the signing request
message.example: Please review and sign this document at your earliest convenience.

routingMode.description: Signing-order mode. parallel (default): all recipients are invited at once. sequential: recipients are activated group-by-group by ascending order value — the next group is only activated once the current group has fully signed.

recipients.description: List of recipients who will sign the document

roleName.description: Role display name snapshot at send time

color.description: Hex colour assigned to this recipient

signedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp when recipient signed

declinedAt.description: Unix ms timestamp when recipient declined

signUrl.description: URL where this recipient can complete signing

ownerId.description: Clerk user ID of the document owner

message.description: Custom message sent with the signing request

documentHash.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the certified final PDF

message.description: Updated message for the signing request
message.example: Please review the updated terms and sign.

apiKeyId.description: API key that performed the action (when applicable)

apiKeyName.description: Human-readable name of the API key used (when applicable)

values.description: Field values as key-value pairs (fieldId -> value)
Completed field values as key-value pairs (fieldId -> value)

consentAcceptedAt.description: Unix timestamp (milliseconds) when consent was accepted

reason.description: Optional reason for declining to sign
reason.example: I need more time to review

url.description: HTTPS URL that Signvoy will POST events to

description.description: Human-readable label for this endpoint (shown in the dashboard)

enabledEvents.description: Events to subscribe to. Pass an empty array to subscribe to all events.

url.description: HTTPS URL Signvoy will POST events to

enabledEvents.description: Subscribed events. Empty array = all events.

successRate.description: Percentage of successful deliveries (null if no deliveries yet)

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret. Shown only once — store it securely. Use it to verify the `Signvoy-Signature` header on inbound events.

url.description: HTTPS URL Signvoy will POST events to

enabledEvents.description: Subscribed events. Empty array = all events.

successRate.description: Percentage of successful deliveries (null if no deliveries yet)

url.description: New HTTPS URL for this endpoint

name.description: Human-readable label to identify this key in the dashboard

expiresInDays.description: Optional expiry, in days from now. Omit for a key that never expires.

prefix.description: Non-secret leading segment of the key

lastUsedAt.description: When the key was last used to authenticate a request

revoked.description: Whether the key has been revoked

key.description: The full secret key. Shown only once, at creation — store it securely. Use it as a Bearer token: `Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...`

prefix.description: Non-secret leading segment of the key

lastUsedAt.description: When the key was last used to authenticate a request

revoked.description: Whether the key has been revoked

documentId.description: UUID of the document whose signing session to embed

documentRecipientId.description: UUID of the specific recipient whose signing view to embed

expiresInSeconds.description: How long (seconds) the returned signing URL should remain valid. Defaults to 1 hour. Maximum is 24 hours.

url.description: Scoped signing URL for the specified recipient. Embed this in an <iframe> or pass it to the @signvoy/react <SignvoyEmbed /> component. The URL is single-use and expires after the requested window.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this session URL expires

documentId.description: Document ID this session belongs to

documentRecipientId.description: Recipient ID this session was issued for

path.description: Request path that produced the error

message.description: Human-readable error message. For validation failures this may be an array of field-level messages.
